hero.headline: The future of dining, built for modern hospitality.
hero.subheadline: Scerv helps restaurants manage reservations, host check-ins, seating, table ordering, kitchen flow, phone payments, reviews, rewards, and reporting in one connected system.

platformStory.title: One connected flow from reservation to payment.
platformStory.intro: Scerv connects the guest phone, host stand, tables, servers, kitchen, checkout, rewards, reviews, and reporting. Restaurants can control the room while guests get a faster, clearer dining experience.

steps.title: Reservations, waitlist, and host check-in
steps.copy: Guests can request reservations or walk-in check-ins. Hosts can approve, decline, seat, assign tables, and manage party status.

steps.title: Phone ordering, tables, servers, and kitchen flow
steps.copy: Guests can order from the table while staff keep modifiers, party orders, server assignment, and kitchen routing organized.

steps.title: Split bills, phone payments, discounts, and receipts
steps.copy: Guests can check out from their phones. Restaurants can track tax, tips, fees, discounts, refunds, promotions, and payout details.

steps.title: Dish reviews, rewards, offers, and guest history
steps.copy: Turn each order into better menu feedback, loyalty progress, reward redemption, food discovery, and repeat-visit data.

platformStory.operatorLine: Scerv is built for the moments restaurants handle every day: guests arriving, tables turning, orders changing, checks closing, rewards applying, and owners needing clean numbers.

analytics.desc: Track sales, tax, tips, service fees, discounts, refunds, promotions, loyalty rewards, dish ratings, customer reviews, and order history.

solutions.title: What Scerv helps restaurants handle
solutions.subtitle: From the host stand to the table to checkout, Scerv gives restaurants practical tools for the moments that decide speed, revenue, and repeat visits.

foh.headline: Reservations, check-ins, seating, and tables

guests.desc: Guests can find dishes, join a party, order from their phones, split and pay the bill, leave reviews on what they ate, earn rewards, and come back with history.

about.heroTitle: Building the operating system for the dining room
about.heroSubtitle: Scerv helps restaurants connect reservations, seating, table ordering, phone checkout, reviews, rewards, and reporting without losing the warmth of great service.
about.missionP1: Dining should feel effortless for guests and manageable for the teams serving them. Guests should be able to reserve, check in, order, pay, review, and earn rewards without adding friction to the room.
about.missionP2: Scerv gives operators one connected view of those moments so hosts, servers, kitchens, managers, and owners can move faster and understand what brings guests back.
about.marketP: New York is one of the most demanding hospitality markets in the world. Brooklyn alone spans neighborhood restaurants, bars, cafes, chef-driven concepts, nightlife, hotels, and ambitious independents. If a platform can respect service culture here, it can scale with credibility.
